newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GOV'T TO DISCUSS EXCISE TAX HIKES.
newsitem.headline: GOV'T TO DISCUSS EXCISE TAX HIKES.

text.p: The Lithuanian finance ministry said on Wednesday that the cabinet will discuss a proposal to raise excise duties on alcohol, tobacco and fuel products.

The ministry said in a statement that the proposal calls for an increase in the excise tax per liter on strong alcoholic beverages to 0.38 litas from 0.30 litas for every percent of alcohol in the product.
Champagne, wine and beer are excluded from the proposal.
The ministry also said that it wanted to raise the excise tax per 1,000 cigarettes to 20 litas for all brands.
The current tax ranges from five to 15 litas per 1,000 cigarettes, depending on the quality of the product.
For petroleum, the ministry has proposed to increase the absolute excise duty per tonne to 800 litas from 560 litas.
The ministry also wants to raise the excise tariff on diesel fuel, jet fuel, liquid heating fuel and kerosene to 300 litas per tonne from 190 litas.
